resources.string: Where the bigger model runs. A LAN address at home, or a tunnel hostname from outside — either works, as long as it is the full URL.
Sent with every request, as Name: value. Worth setting if the server is reachable from the internet: Ollama has no password of its own, so anyone who learns the address can use it.
Lin answers with a model running on this phone, and there is not one here yet. %1$s is about %2$s GB — worth starting on Wi-Fi.
Models are read from, and will be downloaded to:
The last %1$d attempts closed before anything appeared, so this time Lin started with everything switched off. Nothing has been deleted.
Nothing was recorded, which is itself a clue: it means the app was stopped by the system rather than by an error in its own code, and running out of memory is the usual reason.
